plugins.author: Isla
plugins.name: 剪贴板看板
plugins.summary: 把最近的剪贴板内容排成看板：文本、图片、文件都能复制，固定与删除会同步主 App 历史；概览有「最近复制」卡片，胶囊可显示条数。
plugins.summaryEn: Lays recent clipboard items out as a board: text, images and files can be copied; pinning and deleting sync with the main app history. The overview shows a Recent copy card and the capsule can display the item count.

plugins.author: Isla
plugins.name: 数据面板（Web）
plugins.summary: 用自己的 HTML/CSS 画一个网页面板，通过 isla 桥读写存储与剪贴板；演示 kind=web 的插件页。
plugins.summaryEn: Builds a dashboard with your own HTML/CSS and reads/writes storage and the clipboard through the isla bridge; demonstrates a kind=web plugin page.
